verdict.rationale: A probe found an OpenAPI spec published at nextjs.org/openapi.json, which is a thin signal that some documented, machine-readable public API exists. Nothing describes what that API covers or how an AI-native user would drive Next.js through it. The built-in MCP endpoint belongs to a different (MCP) story, and Route Handlers are app-building blocks, so neither is credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of what the OpenAPI spec exposes, a programmatic API for driving Next.js operations (build, dev, deploy), auth and usage guidance, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
